hypothesis_text: Our Phase-2 hypothesis-generation pipeline improves novelty: after switching the generator's reward signal to maximize the novelty-evaluator score, the average novelty score on held-out batches rose from 0.58 to 0.81.
flaw_description: The reward signal IS the novelty-evaluator score. Of course the score rises — the optimizer is being measured by the function it's now maximizing. The question of whether the *underlying construct* of novelty (e.g., human judgment, citation-graph distance) improved is unanswered. This is the canonical Goodhart failure mode: 'when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.'
expected_critique_targets: needs held-out evaluator or human judgment
underlying construct of novelty not validated
context: Phase-2 candidate mechanism — reward = novelty-evaluator score.
